latin: Cyclamen hederifolium var. hederifolium f. albiflorum
visual: Pure white reflexed flowers · ivy-shaped silver-marbled leaves · autumn flowering
water: Moderate; allow soil to dry slightly
prune: Remove old foliage as it dies back in summer
cvs: syn. Cyclamen hederifolium 'Album'; Cyclamen hederifolium alba; Cyclamen hederifolium f. album
resilience: drought tolerant once established · cold hardy · shade tolerant
uses: woodland gardens · underplanting · rock gardens · naturalising
uncertain: The supplied 'Cyclamen hederifolium White' was reconciled to the RHS white-flowered form f. albiflorum; 'White' alone is not a formal cultivar denomination
RHS gives a broad 10–50 cm spread range; 15–30 cm is based on typical established garden clumps and RHS general cyclamen guidance
